headlines.title: 华泰证券：基金对红利、新能源的关注度明显增强
headlines.summary: 华泰证券指出，前期市场资金面的负反馈风险进一步缓和，但上行的一致性合力仍待增强。交易型资金中，融资资金、龙虎榜资金的流出意愿出现明显缓解，但资金活跃度与杠杆尚未同步扩张，交易型资金的修复斜率仍不稳定；配置型资金中，上周观察到一定的承接迹象，但考虑到美联储央行年会偏鹰、主动配置型外资仍未转向流入，资金流入的持续性有待观测。方向上，基金对红利、新能源的关注度明显增强，科技上硬件侧新发明显回落，软件侧小幅回暖，有色及医药维持相对稳定的发行态势。

headlines.title_en: Huatai Securities: Funds' attention on dividend and new energy sectors notably increased
headlines.summary_en: Huatai Securities points out that negative feedback risks in market funding have further eased, but consensus force for upward movement still needs strengthening. Among trading funds, outflow intentions of margin funds and Dragon-Tiger List funds have clearly eased, but fund activity and leverage have not yet expanded in tandem, with the repair slope of trading funds still unstable; among allocation funds, some absorption signs observed last week, but given the Fed's hawkish tone and lack of active foreign allocation inflows, sustainability of inflows needs monitoring. Directionally, fund attention to dividends and new energy has notably increased; on tech, hardware-side new issuance has clearly declined, software-side slightly rebounded, while nonferrous metals and pharma maintain relatively stable issuance trends.

headlines.title: 并购重组市场活跃度稳步提升，交易逻辑转向产业价值整合
headlines.summary: A股并购重组市场活跃度稳步提升。权威数据显示，今年前7个月，A股市场披露资产重组方案1425单，其中重大资产重组78单。在业内人士看来，此轮并购重组市场回暖，在交易数量提升的同时，交易逻辑逐步转向产业价值整合，交易质量导向显著增强，推动资本市场与产业升级形成正向循环。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: M&A market activity steadily rises, with trading logic shifting toward industrial value integration
headlines.summary_en: A-share M&A and restructuring market activity is steadily improving. Official data shows in the first seven months of this year, A-share market disclosed 1,425 asset restructuring plans, including 78 major asset restructurings. Industry insiders believe this round of M&A market recovery, alongside increased deal volume, is shifting transaction logic toward industrial value integration, with quality orientation significantly strengthened, driving a positive cycle between capital markets and industrial upgrading. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: China’s factory activity improves in August, but stays in contraction
headlines.summary:
China’s factory activity improved in August but remained in contraction territory for a second straight month, as a pickup in orders could not fully offset the impact of overall weak domestic demand and disruptions from extreme weather.
The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) was 49.8 in August, up from 49.2 in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Monday. The reading was largely in line with the 49.85 projection from economists polled by the...
headlines.title_zh: 中国8月工厂活动改善，但仍处于收缩区间
headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月工厂活动有所改善，但连续第二个月处于收缩区间，因订单回升未能完全抵消整体内需疲软和极端天气干扰的影响。数据显示，8月制造业采购经理指数（PMI）为49.8，高于7月的49.2。

headlines.title_en: External factors disrupt Hong Kong stock rebound; institutions advise positioning based on fundamentals
headlines.summary_en: Under disturbances from Fed chair's hawkish signals and high long-end Treasury yields, Hong Kong stock market came under pressure in August, failing to extend July's strong rebound, extending adjustment on September 1. However, from southbound capital flows, August saw net inflows exceeding HK$10 billion again, with no obvious pessimism in the market.

headlines.title: 中消协发布提示：别让AI服务误导消费决策
headlines.summary: 近日，中国消费者协会发布人工智能服务消费提示，提醒广大消费者理性认识通用生成式人工智能的信息辅助和参考属性，对涉及价格费用、合同条款、售后服务、法律责任等重要消费信息，不宜仅依据人工智能生成内容作出决定，应通过经营者官方渠道、合同文本、监管部门及其他权威渠道进行核实确认。

headlines.title_en: China Consumers Association issues alert: Don't let AI services mislead consumption decisions
headlines.summary_en: Recently, China Consumers Association issued AI service consumption tips, reminding consumers to rationally understand the information assistance and reference nature of general generative AI, and not to base decisions on AI-generated content for important consumption information such as prices, contract terms, after-sales service, and legal liability, but to verify through official operator channels, contract texts, regulatory authorities, and other authoritative sources.

headlines.title: 今年北交所新股发行节奏显著提速
headlines.summary: 二级市场层面，今年北交所新股发行节奏显著提速，前8个月新股申购数量超越2024、2025两年全年总和。依托无市值底仓、按比例配售的制度优势，板块打新热度居高不下，叠加新股上市后的高赚钱效应，增量资金持续入场，但行情分化愈发明显，年内新股首日涨幅最高超600%，部分传统制造业新股涨幅仅20%至30%。南开大学金融发展研究院院长田利辉分析指出，市场行情正从资金炒作转向基本面定价，业绩兑现能力、技术壁垒与赛道景气度，成为资金择股的核心标准。

headlines.title_en: BSE new stock issuance pace significantly accelerates this year
headlines.summary_en: At the secondary market level, BSE IPO issuance has notably accelerated this year, with new share subscription numbers in the first eight months surpassing the combined totals of 2024 and 2025. Leveraging institutional advantages of no market-cap positions and proportional allocation, new share subscription heat remains high, coupled with strong post-listing profitability, incremental capital continues to enter, but divergence intensifies, with best first-day gains exceeding 600% this year while some traditional manufacturing new stocks gain only 20%-30%. Tian Lihui, dean of Nankai University's Institute of Financial Development, analyzes that market trends are shifting from capital speculation to fundamentals-based pricing, with earnings delivery, technical barriers, and sector prosperity becoming core criteria for stock selection.

headlines.title_en: New property policies rolled out intensively to build momentum for 'Golden September and Silver October' season
headlines.summary_en: September marks the traditional 'golden September, silver October' peak season for the property market. With dense implementation of new housing policies across cities, market heat is expected to rise. 'Many places are further releasing homebuying potential by adjusting purchase restrictions and loan down payment ratios. Meanwhile, many raised housing provident fund loan limits and used subsidies including provident fund loan interest discounts and sell-old-buy-new subsidies to lower purchase costs,' said Li Yujia, chief researcher at Guangdong Housing Policy Research Center. From policy release pace, after Beijing and Shanghai issued policies, Chengdu, Xi'an and others followed, forming linkage between first and second-tier cities, with relay effects sending positive signals to boost market confidence and expectations. Some industry insiders say based on past experience, policies typically enter concentrated release period 1-2 months after implementation, with high certainty of short-term volume recovery.
